what: Two amounts in different currencies were combined or compared.
fix: Convert both amounts to one currency first with `@arki/money/exchange`, then combine them.
verify: cd packages/money && bun run vitest run src/errors.test.ts

what: The currency code is not in the ISO 4217 table and no custom currency was given.
fix: Use an ISO 4217 code, or pass a `Currency.custom({ code, scale })` object instead of a code.
verify: cd packages/money && bun run vitest run src/errors.test.ts

what: No exchange rate is known for the pair, or a rate is invalid.
fix: Pass a rate for the pair, or opt in to `inverse` or `via` on the converter. Rates must be positive.
verify: cd packages/money && bun run vitest run src/exchange.test.ts

what: An amount cannot be expressed in a payment provider's units.
fix: Round the amount to the provider's step first, or choose a currency the provider documents.
verify: cd packages/money && bun run vitest run src/stripe.test.ts

what: The input is longer than the package reads: text over 1000 characters, an exponent or fraction that is too large, or a number with more than about 10 000 digits.
fix: Refuse the input at your boundary. Real amounts are far shorter than these limits.
verify: cd packages/money && bun run vitest run src/failures.test.ts

what: A rate read from a feed is not usable: it is zero or negative, or a rate from a currency to itself is not 1. Thrown builders raise `ExchangeRateError` for the same fault.
fix: Check the feed. A rate is how many units of the quote currency one unit of the base buys, always above 0.
verify: cd packages/money && bun run vitest run src/exchange.test.ts

what: The value has a different shape than `{ amount: string, currency: string }`.
fix: Send `{ amount, currency }` with both fields as strings, as `Money#toJSON()` writes them.
verify: cd packages/money && bun run vitest run src/failures.test.ts

what: The text is not an amount of money in the expected format: wrong characters, misplaced grouping, a different currency's symbol, two signs, mixed digit scripts.
fix: Show the person the expected format, for example `19.99 EUR`. Do not guess a repair.
verify: cd packages/money && bun run vitest run src/failures.test.ts

what: A number is not a safe whole number of minor units: it is fractional, not finite, or past 2^53.
fix: Send minor units as a string or bigint when they may pass 2^53, and never send a fraction.
verify: cd packages/money && bun run vitest run src/failures.test.ts

what: A payment provider amount cannot be read as money: it is not a multiple of the provider's step, it carries a fraction the currency does not have, or the provider has no unit rule for the currency.
fix: Check the provider's amount and currency. Never round a provider amount to make it fit.
verify: cd packages/money && bun run vitest run src/failures.test.ts

what: The amount has more decimals than the currency or scale allows, and no rounding mode was given.
fix: Ask for an amount with fewer decimals, or pass an explicit `rounding` mode to the parser.
verify: cd packages/money && bun run vitest run src/failures.test.ts

what: The currency code or number is not in the ISO 4217 table and no custom currency was listed for it. Thrown builders raise `UnknownCurrencyError` (`ARKI_MONEY_E002`) for the same fault.
fix: Use an ISO 4217 code in upper case, or pass the custom `Currency` objects you accept.
verify: cd packages/money && bun run vitest run src/failures.test.ts

what: The locale tag is not valid, so the runtime's `Intl` cannot give its number format.
fix: Pass a well-formed BCP 47 tag such as `de-DE`, or pass `symbols` to parse without `Intl`.
verify: cd packages/money && bun run vitest run src/failures.test.ts
